dct_description_sm: To address critical knowledge deficiencies concerning anadromous populations of Arctic charr. The overall objective of the work is to characterize local variation in fish growth and to link the variation to observed fluctuations in marine temperatures and Hg loadings as a means of determining the importance of climate change scenarios for possible future shifts in the patterns of growth and contaminant loadings in Arctic charr. In some instances MH gene data are also available to document variation in genetics across populations.
dct_title_s: Eastern Arctic mercury tissue concentration, stable isotope data and major histocompatibility (MH) gene data for Arctic charr
